newsitem.title: USA: CME feeder cattle up to new contract highs.
newsitem.headline: CME feeder cattle up to new contract highs.

text.p: CME feeder cattle futures moved up to new contract highs in most months on growing demand prompted by strong cash and easier corn futures, traders said.

All but April and May set new highs with August up to 82.000 and September up to 81.700 cents, their highest levels since early August 1994. Futures were 0.625 to 0.250 higher with August up most at 81.750 cents.
The latest CME feeder cattle index rose to its highest level since April 1994 on continued strong demand for feeders and lower feed costs, traders said.
